entities.summary: Graciela Aranis, artistically known as Chela Aranís, was a Chilean painter and cartoonist associated with the "Generación del 28" and the Grupo Montparnasse. Graciela Aranis was a authors & novelists from Santiago (1908, Santiago–1996-12-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
